_why: ROM/RAM/CPU budgets for the Athom payload (P2830d). Report-only (warn): a breach prints a WARN and a summary row, never fails the build. Tighten in small steps after the numbers have been stable for a week. Units are MiB. Measured baseline 2026-10-19 (master, after prune): payload 33.6 MiB / 4568 files, app.json 3.93 MB, lib 10.4 MB, drivers 15.3 MB, node_modules 2.7 MB; boot-heap (all 899 modules loaded, upper bound) 45.7 MB heap; 171 setInterval call sites.
